method: Completed DEV scenarios only, seed610017; frozen v40 shared rules19/shot15. 80 evenly spaced ordinary attacking decision states with a carrier and an available dribble. A safe destination has zero immediate clean-tackle risk according to the tested tacticalTackleRisk geometry, including one full normal challenge plus a shared pawn/king bonus setup. This is a geometric immediate-reply audit, not exhaustive adversarial multi-round search. Pass safety is measured on receipt before exploiting the receiver’s own available dribble; keeper back-passes are separate because release is mandatory. No hidden seed was used in calculating move safety.
